texts: mixed: nothing is lost and the query does ask for the reason of the fall, but the wording leaves two things to chance — "fall" reads either as a drop in yield or as "took place in Year 1", and a place phrase hung on the harvest noun ("the thread harvest at the West Row") has no settled encoding, so the row link is recorded here in a different shape from your parallel Middle Row question and the two will not match each other. If you mean the yield dropped, write "Why did the West Row thread harvest decline in Year 1?"; if you mean the harvest was held then, write "Why did the West Row thread harvest take place in Year 1?" — the named premodifier gives the row one fixed encoding either way.
